text:
carmen: Starting canary now for release/2026-03-21. Change window active. Primary watch: embed-route p95 and 5xx rate on eu-west. Putting traffic at 10% initially. :eyes:

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary kickoff: release/2026-03-21 -> nodeset-canary-01. Traffic=10%. Health checks: running.

alex: copying dashboards -> https://graf.redwood/embed-route/slo?range=15m. I'll snapshot baseline and alert thresholds.

morgan: quick heads-up — KV cache miss rate looks slightly higher than baseline on a subset of shards, could affect tail latency. watching.

shreya: seeing p95 climb from ~420ms to ~820ms on canary traces 2m ago. 5xx rate bumped to 0.57% (alert threshold 0.5%). tagging @carmen

carmen: ack. hold traffic at 10%. is the spike correlated with prefix cache TTL changes? any config diffs?

alex: no config diff on code path yet. running this query to correlate errors -> `sum(rate(http_server_errors_total{route="/embed"}[2m])) by (instance)`

ops-bot: Alert: embed-route 5xx > 0.5% for 3m. Severity: warn. Links: https://alerts.redwood/alert/8432

morgan: digging into traces — tail traces show repeated retries from routing layer, look like KV lookup timeouts around 500ms.

carmen: okay - plan: (1) pin canary to model runtime v1.23.4 (the previous runtime) for canary group, (2) drop batch size for this route from 64->32, (3) hold traffic. @alex can you pin and toggle batch?

alex: pinning canary group to runtime=v1.23.4 now. `deploy-bot pin` ->
```
deploy-bot: pinned canary nodeset-canary-01 -> runtime=v1.23.4
```
Changing batch size in routing config and reloading feature flag `embed_batch_size` to 32.

shreya: after pin & batch reduction, p95 trending down to ~480ms over last 90s. 5xx at 0.22% now.

carmen: good. keep at 10% for another 5 minutes, if stable we'll ramp to 25% then 50% before full rollout. No rollback for now. Note this in release notes / postmortem if it recurs.

morgan: filing quick ops note -> https://issues.redwood/OPS-1298 describing KV timeouts observed.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics: p95=480ms, 5xx=0.22%, traffic=10%. All health checks green.

alex: I'm going to enable a transient rate-limiter on retry path as an extra guard (30s TTL) to avoid cascading retries.

shreya: new changes applied. dashboards show small smoothing window, but trend holds.

carmen: ramp to 25% now. watch for any new 5xx surfaces.

ops-bot: Alert resolved: embed-route 5xx resolved. Closing alert 8432.

morgan: backup plan prepared: if 5xx > 0.5% after ramp, immediate rollback to release/2026-03-07 and notify oncall.

carmen: noted. I'll update the release checklist with the pin and config tweak and close this watch thread after the 50% ramp completes. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

alex: 50% reached, metrics stable. I'll draft a short blurb for release notes about the transient runtime pin and batch-size tuning.

shreya: will follow up with traces collection for OPS-1298.

carmen: closing thread in 10m if no regressions.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary traffic scaled to 50%.
